# Agents opened pull requests before running the verify command

## What happened

The trace review of 5 November found three agent pull requests opened before the ticket's verify command had
run. Each failed CI on a check that command runs, and each needed a second push and a second review request.

## What to do next time

Run the ticket's verify command and paste its result into the pull request body before opening it.
